home.title: Welcome to Fixed Rate Lending Platform
home.subtitle: A decentralized platform for fixed-rate lending and borrowing

lending_pool.title: Lending Pool
lending_pool.description: Deposit your assets to earn interest or borrow assets by providing collateral. Our fixed-rate lending pool offers predictable returns and borrowing costs.

unified_matching.title: Unified Matching Engine
unified_matching.description: Create or fulfill lending orders directly with other users. Set your own terms, interest rates, and collateral requirements.

step1.title: 1. Connect Your Wallet
step1.description: Connect your Web3 wallet to interact with the decentralized lending platform.

step2.title: 2. Deposit or Borrow
step2.description: Deposit your assets to earn interest, or borrow assets by providing sufficient collateral.

step3.title: 3. Earn or Pay Fixed Rates
step3.description: Earn predictable interest on your deposits or pay fixed interest on your loans.
